Question No. 20 to 26 is short answer type. Answer any 4 questions. Each question carries 2 marks. (4x2=8)
20. Mention two differences between 'Artery' and 'Vein'.                     (2)
21. What are the functions of digestive enzymes?                            (2)
22. How are water and minerals transported in plants?                       (2)
23. How does phototropism occur in plants?                                  (2)
24. Draw a labelled diagram of female reproductive system.                  (2)
25. How do we get to know how old the fossils are?                          (2)
26. Why depletion of ozone layer is threat to us?                           (2)
Long Answer Type Questions
Questions No. 27 and 28 are Long Answer Type questions. Answer any one of the following. (5x1=5)
27. Draw the well labelled structure of a neuron and explain its functions.    (5)
28. Draw a well labelled diagram of human respiratory system and explain its functions.    (5)
